title: Your Card Debt Doubles in 3 Years. Your Savings? 180.

cardRate.unit: % APR, commercial bank credit card plans, accounts assessed interest (not seasonally adjusted)
cardRate.period: 2026 Q3 (preliminary); Q2 2026 was 22.15%, all accounts Q3 21.19%
cardRate.source: Federal Reserve G.19 Consumer Credit, published 2026-11-06; https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g19/20261106/g19.pdf (re-read 2026-11-11)

savingsRate.unit: % APY, FDIC national average rate, savings
savingsRate.source: FDIC National Rate: Savings via FRED series SNDR, updated 2026-10-19; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/SNDR (re-read 2026-11-11)

cardBalances.unit: trillion USD, US credit card balances
cardBalances.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Household Debt and Credit Report Q3 2026, published 2026-11-10; https://www.newyorkfed.org/newsevents/news/research/2026/20261110 (logged at scripting 2026-11-11; not re-opened at build)

exampleBalance.source: Illustrative. Monthly compounding at the rates above, no payments, no new charges or fees, constant rates. Computed in code (scenes/math.ts): 12-month card interest ≈ $1,240, savings ≈ $19; doubling time card ≈ 3.13 yrs, savings ≈ 182.4 yrs

notes: Doubling times and the $5,000 example are illustrative: monthly compounding, no payments, no new charges, constant rates. Most cards compound daily; minimum payments apply in practice.
G.19 Q3 2026 rate is preliminary and covers commercial-bank card accounts assessed interest only.

voice.pauseCompression: internal pauses longer than 0.28 s shortened to 0.28 s (silence only, no words cut)
voice.format: 48 kHz stereo WAV, 30.0 s, -14 LUFS target, -1.5 dBTP
voice.transcriptionCheck: All five clips matched the script, every number correct (Speko audio.transcribe, 2026-11-11)
voice.captionTiming: Caption chunks start ~0.1 s before each sentence, anchored to the measured pauses in each clip (after trim, pause compression and tempo)
